root_cause: At s7437 r2 (P1 Custodes, Reconnaissance Sweep primary: 3 quarters 3 VP / 4 quarters 6 VP at the END of every turn) P1's other units covered quarters 0 and 1; Beta entering quarter 2 makes the 3-quarter tier (+3 VP this turn, again every turn it stays). The planner's only quarter term was a flat secondary_spread 4.2 (6.0 x 0.7) on the walking end point, which (a) is the same for any uncovered quarter whatever the card pays and (b) is also given to points within 6" of the centre that never count. Three things then sank Beta's obj_nml_2 candidate (30.7 vs 48.2 for reinforcing the held centre): it was costed as a 3-turn objective race (contest_race -13.5, distance_penalty -5.4) although the quarter pays this turn regardless of the objective; RACE-1 refused the free Advance because its test counts any ranged weapon in range as a shooting cost, ignoring [ASSAULT] (Guardian Spear), and a walk stops on the quarter line; and pass-2 RACE-SKIP vetoed the candidate as a lost objective race. A/B replay (2 seeds): B gained 'quarters +3 (best tier)' at R2 end of turn in both seeds, A in neither (A only reached it at R3 in one seed). Finding 2 (s7418 r1 P2 Mek B) has drifted on the current AI: its top-scored candidate is already Advance obj_center (16.5), but it is assigned to obj_home_2 by a later pass - not a quarter mechanism, so this design does not touch it.
fix_summary: QUARTER-VP (FIX_REINFORCE_INSURANCE=1): when the player's cards pay for table quarters (primary 'quarters' eot rules; Engage on All Fronts 3/5), each movement candidate gets quarter_vp = (tier VP with this unit's end-of-move quarter added - tier VP of the quarters our OTHER units cover) x (1 + 0.5 x own turns left after this one) x 3.5 score/VP, replacing the flat secondary_spread bonus. Presence is tested like the scorer: footprint wholly inside one quarter, more than 6" from the centre. A holder is tested where it stands, so a unit giving the tier keeps that value for staying (durable). A long-trip Normal move that stops short of an uncovered quarter becomes an Advance when the Advance end point reaches it and Advancing costs nothing (RACE-1 test with [ASSAULT] ranged weapons not counted as a shooting cost; no enemy within M+12"). In pass 2 a candidate that takes an uncovered quarter this turn is not vetoed by RACE-SKIP / TOO-LATE (they judge the objective; the race loss stays priced in contest_race), and a second unit is not sent into a quarter another unit already takes when without its quarter_vp it is below its best other option. Log tag [REINFORCE_INSURANCE]. 0 = base behaviour exactly (the old flat bonus comes back).

The quarter_vp score term itself (no log line) is active only for a player whose primary is Reconnaissance Sweep or who holds Engage on All Fronts.
risks: 1) Rounds 3-5: the term rewards keeping the unit that makes the tier inside its quarter (hold candidate valued where it stands), so a quarter-holder may decline to leave for an objective or a charge-lane move worth less than ~3.5 x tier VP x persistence (persistence falls from 2.5 at R2 to 1.0 at R5, so the pull fades late, when objectives also matter most). It never vetoes charges or the fight phase (s7418 r3 guardrail unchanged). 2) Secondary cards: it only fires for quarter cards; it replaces the flat 6.0 Engage on All Fronts bonus with the 11e tiers (3 quarters 3, 4 quarters 5), so at 0-1 quarters covered a 2nd quarter now gets 0 instead of 6 - EoAF play will spread less eagerly until 2 quarters are already held; cards needing units across the table (Centre Ground, Behind Enemy Lines) are untouched. Units no longer get the old 4.2 for heading into a point within 6" of the centre. 3) RACE-SKIP / TOO-LATE exemption: a unit can now walk/Advance toward an objective the enemy will out-OC (at s7437: ~32 Ork OC near obj_nml_2), for the quarter; if it dies there the presence lasts one turn only (persistence assumes 0.5 per later turn). LONE-TRIP / FAR-TRIP / DIM-RETURNS still veto. 4) Presence is approximated from the centroid + footprint along a straight line; terrain/pathing may stop the unit short (then it scores like the walk did). 5) The Advance is chosen only when RACE-1's charge test passes (no enemy within M+12"), so it never gives up a possible charge; [ASSAULT] detection is by special_rules text. 6) Over-claim: two units entering the same quarter are handled only in pass 2 (claim check); OBJ-ASSIGN-1 / backfill passes do not know the claim. 7) Only one finding position changed; the effect is narrow (1 of 25 bench pairings has Recon Sweep, plus EoAF draws), so a full-game bench needs many Recon Sweep games to measure it.
